WSP is an award-winning consultancy that employees the largest number of chartered town planners across the UK, operating within both the infrastructure and property markets. It has never been a more exciting time to join WSP’s market-leading Infrastructure Planning Team. Our success is built on employing highly skilled consenting specialists that have experience in serving a diverse portfolio of clients in the energy, renewables, nuclear, net zero, water, rail and transportation and aviation sectors.We work at all stages of the consenting process from early feasibility, application preparation and delivery of consents through construction and on a variety of projects across sectors.

With notable contract and framework awards from National Grid as part of the Great Grid Partnership as well as awards from many other clients, we have a great foundation for growth in 2026.

Our key clients include National Grid as part of the Great Grid Partnership, National Gas as part of Project Union, Nuclear Waste Services, EET Fuels, Eni UK, SSE, Scottish Power Renewables, Severn Trent Water, Southern Water, United Utilities, Yorkshire Water, and many more.

To continue to sustainably grow as a business, we are looking for an experienced Senior Consultant to join our team to support town planning and consenting inputs on major and nationally significant infrastructure projects. The successful candidates will have demonstrable experience of working within multi-disciplinary teams to secure consent and approvals for major or nationally significant infrastructure projects via the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, Planning Act 2008 and Transport and Works Act Order. We are also interested to hear from people that have experience in securing consents for major projects by means of the Planning (Wales) Act 2015, Town and Country Planning (Scotland) Act, or the Electricity Act.

To find out more about our Infrastructure Planning business click on the following link and discover what awaits you at WSP: Infrastructure planning and consulting | WSP

Help prepare Town & Country Planning Act applications for infrastructure projects across the UK.
Support providing consenting inputs on major infrastructure projects (DCOs, DNSs, TWAOs etc)
Assisting with providing technical advice to project managers to support client's requirements.
Supporting liaison with statutory bodies and stakeholders on behalf of clients to help deliver projects.
Ability to engage with teams across a variety of disciplines, building positive relationships within the team.
Proactively engages with developing own knowledge and skills to build ability and team’s internal knowledge base.
Degree level qualification in town planning (or equivalent).
Member of (or eligible for) the RTPI.

jobs.description:
About the Role:

We have a current opening for a E-Commerce Customer Commercial Planning Analyst and are actively reviewing applications.

The E-Commerce Customer Commercial Planning Analyst
supports customer forecasting, promotional planning, trade-spend tracking, and business performance reporting for assigned customers and channels. Working closely with Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, and Trade Marketing teams, this role helps maintain forecast accuracy, monitor customer investments, analyze business performance, and provide insights that support commercial decision-making. The position is ideal for a professional looking to build expertise in customer planning, commercial analytics, and revenue management within a fast-paced consumer goods environment.

This role is hybrid and will be based out of our North American HQ in Parsippany, NJ.

Main Responsibilities:

Volume Planning & Forecast Management
Guide and coordinate the commercial planning process with focus on short-term forecasting (within FY) for customers under scope
With the support of Sales, collect and share all the commercial inputs needed for baseline forecast cleansing activity purpose s with Demand Planning
Review with Sales the total forecast at customer / channel level, highlighting any risk and/or opportunities and related adjustments needed for the relative stakeholders
Review total market forecast in preparation of Customer DMR, framing key risks, opportunities and recommended commercial actions within short-term forecast horizon
Ensure coherence among short-term vs long term volumes as defined in S&OP Board considering both customer perspective as well as more aggregated level perspective
Promotional Planning & Optimization
Optimize promo plan within customer scope rebalancing mix and intensity based on post-event learnings
Collaborate with Sales (KAM) on promo plan construction including proper quantification of promotional uplift
Monitor and ensure promo execution in coherence with promo guidelines defined by R&TM – Pricing team, ensuring commercial plans are aligned with value and profitability objective
Trade Spend & Financial Management
Monitor total trade spend (actual vs BDG) in close coordination with Finance monthly
Plan BDG / SAF for trade-spend funds in coordination with Finance
Approve any request on promo activities (Within customers under scope)
Monitor the P&L of the customer including key performance indicators such as Profit Pool, Customer Margin trade Margin %, Promotion ROI, and mix management.
Support Joint Business planning process and develop customer argumentation for suggested changes to promotion and pricing strategy leveraging RMT capability (Profit pool, Fair treatment, ROI, etc)
Commercial Performance Analysis
Provide fact-based insights on customer performance, business trends, and growth opportunities.
Identify risks, opportunities, and drivers impacting volume, profitability, and customer investment returns.
Develop reporting and performance scorecards to support customer reviews and commercial decision-making.
Deliver recommendations that improve forecast accuracy, promotional effectiveness, and financial results.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Customer Planning
Partner with Sales, Trade Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing, and IT teams to support customer planning processes.
Contribute to Joint Business Planning (JBP) activities and strategic customer initiatives.
Facilitate alignment across stakeholders to ensure successful execution of customer plans.
Support customer reviews, business updates, and commercial planning discussions.

About You:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, Economics, Supply Chain, Analytics, or a related field.
1-3 years of experience in Sales Analytics, Commercial Finance, Business Planning, Demand Planning, Trade Marketing, Category Management, or a related commercial function.
Experience supporting forecasting, reporting, budgeting, or business performance analysis activities.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to organize, analyze, and interpret data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
Strong communication and organizational skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Trade Marketing teams.
Demonstrated ability to learn quickly, work independently, and proactively solve problems.
Exposure to customer planning, trade spend management, sales operations, or financial reporting processes preferred.
Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with SAP, Power BI, Tableau, or other reporting tools is a plus.

Experience developing geoprocessing workflows using ModelBuilder.
Experience publishing and managing GIS services.
Strong understanding of enterprise geodatabases, spatial data management, and GIS architecture.
Experience performing spatial analysis and producing high-quality cartographic products.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
